title: デビュー戦の後に・栄光の楯へと

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen is overcome with emotion following her debut race, having taken a step toward conquering the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning the race would honor her grandparents and earn her accolades as a stayer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She stirs with motivation, ready to further improve her skills with the time she has remaining until spring.
